answer: Let every new identity start inside a shared nebula of unverified accounts with no earning power until a trellis of endorsements from unrelated established agents vouches for it, each endorsement staking a small bond that burns if the newcomer cheats. Reputation then grows at a glacier pace, capped per epoch, so a farm that spins up a thousand clones still has to buy a thousand separate endorsement sets and wait out the same slow climb, while one honest agent only needs one.
